info.title: IEMS Core API
info.description: Canonical OpenAPI 3.1.0 specification for IEMS (Integrated Enterprise Manufacturing & Repair System). Enforces exact decimal strings for currency and quantities, server-side session RBAC per plant, and idempotency guarantees on state mutations.

BearerAuth.description: Bearer token for automation or integration workers

BadgeToken.name: X-Badge-Token
BadgeToken.description: Kiosk operator NFC badge assertion token

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-supplied unique key for guaranteed at-most-once execution.

PlantId.name: X-Plant-Id
PlantId.description: Active plant operational context for plant-scoped commands.

Decimal.description: Exact non-negative decimal string (e.g. "1250000.00" or "42"). Floating point numbers are prohibited.

SignedDecimal.description: Exact signed decimal string (e.g. "-150.00" or "42"). Floating point numbers are prohibited.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of why the field failed validation.

code.description: Optional specific error code for field.

message.description: Human-readable message explaining the failure and remediation steps.

correlationId.description: Unique trace identifier for tracing the request across server logs.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when error occurred.

path.description: Canonical API path of the request.

fieldErrors.description: Specific validation errors per field, if applicable.

details.description: Structured metadata clarifying the conflict or constraint violation.

requestHash.description: SHA-256 digest of method + canonical path + serialized body.
